# Woods Crossing Apartments

> Woods Crossing is a North Salt Lake apartment community at 850 N. Hwy 89, North Salt Lake, UT 84054. The source site lists one- and two-bedroom apartment homes, a swimming pool, clubhouse, playground, covered parking, onsite management, pet-friendly policies, and current availability copied on August 6, 2026.

Canonical site: https://www.woodscrossingslc.com/

Last source scrape: 2026-08-06
